login.createDescription: Create a new account to get started
login.signinHint: Already have an account? Sign In
login.ssoFailed: Couldn't start SSO sign-in. Try again.
login.ssoRequiredDescription: This server only allows SSO sign-in. Use the sign-in page to continue.
login.ssoUnavailable: SSO-only sign-in is enabled, but no SSO provider is available. Ask an administrator to check the SSO environment variables.
login.unableToConnectDescription: We couldn't reach the server. Try again.

errors.accountAlreadyRegistered: That email is already registered. Try signing in.
errors.couldNotCreateAccount: Couldn't create that account. Try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password doesn't match.
errors.invalidTotp: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator and try again.
errors.signupDisabledDevHint: Local development: add your email to ADMIN_EMAILS in .env (or re-run pnpm run setup), restart the dev server, then sign up with that address.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successDescription: If an account exists for that email, we sent a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.failed: Couldn't send a reset link. Try again.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.failed: Couldn't reset your password. Request a new link and try again.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or expired
resetPassword.invalidDescription: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one to continue.

verifyEmail.sentDescription: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.
verifyEmail.successDescription: Your email address is confirmed. Sign in to get started.
verifyEmail.pendingDescription: Your account needs a verified email address before you can sign in. Enter your email to get a fresh verification link.
verifyEmail.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or expired
verifyEmail.invalidDescription: Verification links expire after an hour and can only be used once. Enter your email to get a new one.
verifyEmail.resent: If that account still needs verification, we sent a new link. Check your email.
verifyEmail.emailUnavailable: Email delivery isn't configured on this server. Ask an administrator to verify your account.
verifyEmail.accountCreatedNoEmail: Your account for {{email}} was created, but email delivery isn't configured on this server, so no verification link was sent. Ask an administrator to verify your account before signing in.
verifyEmail.notVerified: Verify your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the verification link.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.emailCodeDescription: Enter the code we just emailed you
twoFactor.codeSent: We've emailed you a verification code
twoFactor.couldNotSendCode: Couldn't send a code. Try again.
twoFactor.requiredDescription: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Please set it up to continue.
twoFactor.introText: You'll need an authenticator app like Authy, Google Authenticator, or 1Password to generate verification codes.
twoFactor.passwordPrompt: Enter your password to begin setup.
twoFactor.passwordlessPrompt: If you sign in with SSO and do not have a password, continue without entering one.
twoFactor.scanQrPrompt: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.addKeyToApp: Add this key to your authenticator app:
